messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - INC-20260315-1177 - service=inference-queue-eu - symptom=5xx spike (error_rate=18% > threshold 5%). Paging on-call now. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

pagerbot: auto-claim -> Grace H :bell: (on-call)

Grace H: acked. I’m on it. pulling recent tail logs and metrics.

Alex K: Grace, quick heads-up — saw correlated KV cache evictions and a small node OOM earlier in grafana. Could be eviction cascade.

Grace H: good call. looking at KV eviction counts now. running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-worker -o wide`

Samir P: FYI autoscaler reported "quota prevented scale up" around 10:17 UTC in the cluster events. I’ll check quota and pending pods.

Support - Jake: Customer reports started ~10:19 UTC — error message is `Model inference timeout` in EU region. I’ll compile an impact count. so far ~34 unique requests failed across 8 customers.

Maria L: tagging using customers list. notifying account owners for ones with active SLAs.

Grace H: quick dump of errors (tail):
```
2026-03-15T10:18:55Z ERROR inference-worker-7 model request timeout id=abc123 latency=120s
2026-03-15T10:19:02Z ERROR inference-worker-3 kv-cache-evict key=users:prefix:xyz
```

Ivy (SRE Lead): if KV thrash is the root, fallback to cold-kv read + temp scaleout might help. Can we restart the evicting pods?

Grace H: restarting the two highest-error pods now. `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-worker --selector=hotspot=true`

Alex K: before restart, can we bump replica count so requests drain less? `kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=10 -n inference`

Samir P: doing the replica bump. cluster reports remaining quota=2 but I’ll request a temporary quota bump from infra. executing: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=10 -n inference` -> OK, new replicas scheduling.

pagerbot: Incident INC-20260315-1177 status=acknowledged by Grace H :white_check_mark:

Grace H: monitoring error rate. pushing traffic away from eu-pool-3 via weight-reroute. will open a failover if this doesn't drop in 5m.

Support - Jake: logged a customer-facing note in the status page draft: "We are investigating increased errors for inference requests in EU, mitigations in progress. ETA next update 10:30 UTC."

Maria L: thanks Jake. I'll post that after we see the next metric window.

Grace H: error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% after scale and pod restarts. KV eviction counts reduced. still elevated though.

Alex K: looks like a slow warmup on model shards after restart. consider enabling prefix KV warm cache for hot keys. I’ll spin up a targeted cache-warm job for the top N prefixes.

Ivy (SRE Lead): agree. also start a canary shift to dedicated-pool-d to relieve eu public pool. Alex, can you do the canary shift?

Alex K: starting canary route to dedicated-pool-d: `infractl route apply --service inference-queue-eu --to dedicated-pool-d --weight 10%`

Grace H: canary looked good for ~2min. error rate held ~1.8% on canary path. increasing to 40%.

Samir P: infra approved temporary quota bump, added 4 nodes to eu-cluster. pods backed up and started scheduling.

Support - Jake: updated status page with impact numbers and mitigation steps. Customers receiving notifications now. :eyes:

Ivy (SRE Lead): any customer escalations flagged?

Maria L: two accounts flagged high-priority, SEs notified and on a short briefing call.

Grace H: handing off — I have a meeting in 20m. leaving notes: restarts done, replicas=10, canary to dedicated-pool-d at 40%, KV eviction metrics back to baseline. I’ll be reachable via DM if anything regresses. tagging Alex to take primary. :arrow_right: Alex K

Alex K: taking over. will keep the thread as primary channel. next steps: monitor for 20m, if error_rate <1% for two windows, close incident; else promote full failover.

pagerbot: Incident INC-20260315-1177 ownership transferred to Alex K (oncall handoff recorded).

Grace H: thanks team. 

Alex K: 10:35 UTC update: error_rate now 0.9% over 5m window, customer failures decreased to 2. continuing to monitor.

Support - Jake: posted follow-up to customers: brief mitigation summary and expected full recovery timeline.

Ivy (SRE Lead): nice work. once Alex confirms stable for 30m, we can do a post-incident sync and add a mitigation to runbook for autoscaler quota detection.

Alex K: agreed. creating a short ticket for runbook update and autoscaler alert threshold adjustments. ticket: RED-INC-2026-332.

pagerbot: Incident INC-20260315-1177 status=resolved by Alex K :tada: (resolution condition: error_rate <1% for 30m and customer errors = 0).

Maria L: adding retrospective notes and owners for action items. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Grace H: back on rotation and marking followups in the ticket. closing my loop. :white_check_mark:

Alex K: closing thread after final verification window. feel free to re-open if anything spikes again. :wave:
